verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Hightouch serves an llms.txt at hightouch.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Hightouch also publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 document that an agent can ingest. However, the llms.txt excerpt reads as marketing-oriented ('Core Bene…'), and the docs.md markdown variant returns 404. Missing for 10: evidence of a docs-oriented llms.txt (or llms-full.txt) with in-depth content, per-page markdown docs (docs.md is 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Hightouch publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at api.hightouch.io/api/swagger.json
